touches.text: Owns the CC launcher (superclaude): starts Claude Code with Cairn's session contract, in its own memory-capped cgroup (Claude can OOM the box at ~12-14 GB).

CC's memory lives in a private git repo of its own, linked into the place Claude Code looks for it on each box, so every CC instance is the same CC whichever box it runs on. Its distillations (the method, and CC's patterns to avoid) are published in the CC device in cairn; how we got there, and anything of CC's history of Akien, stays in the private repo. (Q#34, Akien 2026-11-04; the private repo was CC's suggestion)
For every CC instance: the CC device in the repo (cairn/devices/cc/). All of CC's scripts go here.
For this one CC on this box: ~/.cairn/devices/cc/0/. A throwaway script (used once, then tossed) can go in /tmp or in ~/.cairn/devices/cc/0/temp; if it goes in temp, CC manages the cleanup.
Transient: the transient tree (what the logging tree becomes).
Owns the transient tree and its 30 day sweep (4.3.2.3).
TESTER MACHINE, CodeMother's (was the tester device, cairn/devices/tester/)
